meta.title: EvoOntology semantic layer
meta.description: A versioned, evidence-grounded semantic layer (ontology) for the current agent, inspired by ruc-datalab/EvoOntology and implemented as a native DSH plugin. Registers 11 evo_* tools (status / browse / resolve / history / read-only query / task start / task finish / commit / publish / revert / export), an /evo command, three skills (build, use, evolve), and one line of ontology state in the system prompt (version, node counts, how long ago it was published). Semantics live in one SQLite file at $DSH_HOME/evoontology/store.db, opened in-process: no Python, no child process, no network. Terms, field mappings and constraints must cite a re-runnable observation, and versions are immutable, diffable and free to roll back. The only data executor, evo_query, is read-only: a text gate admits SELECT/WITH only, and a SQLite authorizer whitelists SELECT/READ/FUNCTION/RECURSIVE, capped at 100 rows, 2 KB per value and 5 s. Data stays local: only evidence digests and re-runnable probes are stored, never sample rows. Disabling the bundle removes the tools, command and skills; store.db and runs/ are kept — delete $DSH_HOME/evoontology to clean up completely.
